# ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry Daily Update (Jun 2, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on devnet progress, `op-revm` synchronization, and addressing interop transaction pool issues, including a new runbook for invalid interop message recovery.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS

## CLOSED ISSUES

## NEW ISSUES
### Interop Transaction Pool and Recovery
New issues were opened to address critical problems with the interop transaction pool and the recovery process after invalid interop messages. This includes an issue where `op-reth`'s transaction pool does not resume after a failsafe is disabled, requiring a restart of `op-reth` and `op-rbuilder` [#21149](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21149). Additionally, a new issue proposes the creation of a runbook for recovering a chain after an invalid interop message triggers a reorg [#21161](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21161).

## ACTIVE ISSUES
### Devnet Spin-up Progress
Discussion on [#20691](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20691) indicates progress on spinning up a devnet. As of June 2nd, a local devnet is running, with the next step being the establishment of a long-running devnet. Previously, the plan was to await `glamsterdam-devnet-4` images before attempting a full devnet.

### `op-revm` Synchronization and Updates
Issue [#21069](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21069) discusses the synchronization of `op-revm` with new `revm` releases. A comment on June 2nd highlights the community's interest in REVM's latest release (v111), which includes WIP support for the Amsterdam hardfork. The Optimism team aims to stay in sync with new `revm` releases, with dependency updates expected when `reth` dependencies are updated. Guides will be updated to ensure more eager dependency updates.

### Interop Transaction Pool Recovery
Issue [#21149](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21149) details a problem where `op-reth`'s transaction pool does not resume accepting interop transactions after the `op-interop-filter` failsafe is disabled, requiring a restart. The latest comment on June 2nd clarifies that restarting **both `op-reth` and `op-rbuilder`** on the sequencers is necessary to restore interop functionality. A failsafe-state gauge metric is proposed in [#21151](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21151) to improve observability of this state.

### Invalid Interop Message Recovery Runbook
Issue [#21161](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21161) proposes creating a runbook for recovering a chain after an invalid interop message triggers a reorg. A comment on June 2nd suggests that the runbook should cover issues such as [#21149](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21149), [#20006](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20006), and [#21125](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/21125), in addition to ensuring the failsafe is disabled.
